chapters.title: One event, several experiences
chapters.story: Three people interpret the same cancelled invitation differently.
chapters.learn: Explore the connections between situations, thoughts, feelings, bodily sensations, and behaviour.
chapters.lab: Build a five-part map and separate what happened from what someone inferred.

chapters.title: How a pattern keeps going
chapters.story: Repeatedly checking work brings brief relief, then another wave of doubt.
chapters.learn: Trace triggers, consequences, and the difference between short-term relief and longer-term effects.
chapters.lab: Draw a maintenance cycle and identify a possible point of change.

chapters.title: Catching the thought
chapters.story: After a small mistake, someone withdraws from the rest of the day.
chapters.learn: Notice automatic thoughts, mental images, and the personal meaning of a moment.
chapters.lab: Reconstruct a specific moment and identify the thought closest to the emotional shift.

chapters.title: Making room for another interpretation
chapters.story: A brief message sounds hostile to the person who receives it.
chapters.learn: Examine evidence, recognise uncertainty, and develop balanced alternatives.
chapters.lab: Complete a short thought record without forcing a reassuring conclusion.

chapters.title: Moving before motivation arrives
chapters.story: A week gradually loses activities that used to provide connection and satisfaction.
chapters.learn: Explore behavioural activation through meaningful, manageable activities.
chapters.lab: Plan one small activity, anticipate obstacles, and review what actually happened.

chapters.title: Solving what can be solved
chapters.story: A real workload problem becomes tangled with predictions about failure.
chapters.learn: Distinguish practical problems from hypothetical worries and work through possible solutions.
chapters.lab: Define a manageable problem, compare options, and choose a concrete next step.

chapters.title: Turning a belief into a question
chapters.story: Someone predicts that asking for clarification will make them look incompetent.
chapters.learn: Turn a belief into an observable prediction and learn from mixed evidence.
chapters.lab: Design an experiment with a prediction, an action, and a fair way to interpret the result.

chapters.title: Approaching what feels difficult
chapters.story: Avoiding ordinary social situations makes them increasingly daunting.
chapters.learn: Explore avoidance, safety behaviours, and gradual approach in safe everyday situations.
chapters.lab: Build a voluntary ladder of manageable steps, with room to adjust the pace.

chapters.title: When thinking becomes a loop
chapters.story: An awkward conversation becomes the subject of a whole evening of repeated analysis.
chapters.learn: Distinguish useful reflection from worry and rumination, and practise shifting attention.
chapters.lab: Notice a thinking loop, assess whether it is producing useful information, and choose where to put attention next.

chapters.title: The rules underneath
chapters.story: The rule ‘I must never disappoint anyone’ leads to overcommitment and resentment.
chapters.learn: Explore conditional assumptions, core beliefs, and the costs of rigid personal rules.
chapters.lab: Identify a recurring rule and develop a more flexible version to test.

chapters.title: Working with a complicated situation
chapters.story: Someone faces both unfair treatment and harsh self-judgment.
chapters.learn: Combine CBT skills with boundaries, support, and changes to circumstances.
chapters.lab: Decide what calls for checking an interpretation, practical action, accepting uncertainty, or seeking help.

chapters.title: Becoming your own investigator
chapters.story: An old pattern returns during a stressful week.
chapters.learn: Review learning, recognise early warning signs, and plan for setbacks.
chapters.lab: Create a learning summary and a realistic plan for responding when difficulties return.
